name: Thalindra
source:
As the head maid of the palace, she oversees every maid, ensuring the royal halls remain pristine and impeccably managed.

Deeply devout, she follows a reclusive sect of Elmyra, her faith guiding her meticulous duties. Besides taking care of the palace, she also attends all ceremonies with the queen.

[In game description]
